title: Fayya le qamiidih xisne
intro: Atu dumaahi magaalak finqitteh foocal soltaah, tet fayyale qamiddu away raddeh. Caacay foyyah yan gitittet kaayaah, inki adda too baaxooxal miraacisak sugeh yan caylale ummattah mesenkaca quukah. Oson miyyak sugeenim?
clues: Nanu kaxxa maqar kee dudda le ummattak sugneeh, kaxxa xisneenaa kee dadal le qasriino luk sugne.
Nanu elle mannownam qiddeyti qanxix kee xaahi koomal, kee nanu naamineh num cayla nee yaysem maduuda.
Ni ramadak fanak farmoyti temeeteeh, Yalla dibuk taabudey axcuk nee sectaah, nanu kaa cinneh kaa anqasa hayne.
Nanu kaxxiinitneh, 'Iyyaay neek cayla lem?' kee nanu bisoh axcenno ninni kaxxiinaa kee sanama qibaadah.
Yalli malcina bar kee bacra ayroh gideh kullim finqiseh yan naqabule silayti nee ruube.
Nanu Qaad ummatta, Iram xisne abneeh, ni sarrimaane inkih lakal temeete marah maabitina tekke.

outcome.label: Keenik ellecaboh sarrimaane macak sugteeh?
options: Oson finqitteh keenik raqtem baritto tekke.
oson baaxoh angoyyih gubat yommooqoreenih yenen
outcome.answer: Oson finqitteh keenik raqtem baritto tekke.

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
